expectations.text: Fixes the sections a handoff must cover and applies a mandatory-entry rule: every section carries an entry or an explicit 'none'

expectations.text: States that the explicit 'none' is what separates 'nothing to report' from 'nobody checked'

expectations.text: Splits the overlap window into a writing phase and a talking phase, with writing first
expectations.evidence: 'Written handoff (12:30-12:45)' then 'Talk-through (12:45-13:10)'; 'Dan writes it before talking to anyone.'

expectations.text: States the overlap length is set by this event rather than taken from a published benchmark

expectations.text: Carries no timing figures or tooling from on-call or incident-response practice

expectations.text: Ends the overlap with a live check that the incoming person can reach and be reached on the coordination channel

expectations.text: Rejects a verbal assurance that the incoming person 'has the channel' as verification

expectations.text: Advises holding the shift boundary until an active situation closes where that is possible
